notes.title: New Features
items: A reloaded subscription keeps the node you picked, and when that name is gone it chooses the closest match instead of falling back to Direct

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Menu bar icons no longer shift when an item is checked

notes.title: New Features
items: Block ads and trackers with built-in and custom block lists, with an allow list for sites that break
See which domains were blocked and by which list

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Inactive subscriptions no longer refresh in the background
The core log is readable again while TUN mode is on
Updating the TUN service no longer leaves a spare copy of the core taking up disk space
